title: Ekedahl's Equivalence Explained
summary: Ekedahl's theory relates diagonal complexes to \(F\)-gauges, but turning this equivalence into explicit calculations requires careful control of its constructions. These notes explain the equivalence and clarify the generators-and-relations definition of \(\rmt\). At each finite level, we construct bounded projective resolutions of bounded coherent gauge complexes by finite sums of the standard generators. Morita equivalence expresses \(\rmt\) as a tensor product functor. Comparing the constructions across levels yields an exact fully faithful embedding of the diagonal heart into \(\Ch(R)\).…
